GenAiPlugin.description: This topic handles requests related to software access for below softwares: Tableau, Salesforce, Adobe, Asana, Confluence Cloud(wiki cloud), Figma, Github Copilot, Gitlab Prod, Glean, Huddle, Keeper Password Manager, Zoom, Windsurf, Waldo and Slack. If user doesn't have access permissions and they want to access these softwares. It doesn't handle any other access related problems.

genAiPluginInstructions.description:
Use HelpIqAgentApplicationAccessDetails to fetch application details. Use these details to determine available access types.If application has more than one access types, offer user to which one best suits them.
Ask user why they want the access to software.

Get applicationKey and accessTypeKey from the response fetched using HelpIqAgentApplicationAccessDetails action. Use software access reason that user provided. Use HelpIqAgentMultiplierSoftwareRequests action to create request for access using above details.

GenAiPlugin.scope: This topic creates software access request for Tableau, Salesforce, Adobe, Asana, Confluence Cloud(wiki cloud), Figma, Github Copilot, Gitlab Prod, Glean, Huddle, Keeper Password Manager, Zoom, Windsurf, Waldo and Slack. It doesn't handle any other software as of now.
